title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 147
description: Ten questions on Psalms 147: the God who heals the brokenhearted, counts the stars, and sends snow, frost and hail.

questions.text: What city does Yahweh build up, gathering together the outcasts of Israel?
questions.explanation: The psalm says, "Yahweh builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel."

questions.text: What does Yahweh do for the broken in heart?
questions.explanation: The psalm says he heals the broken in heart and binds up their wounds.

answers.text: He gives them a new song
He heals them and binds up their wounds
He hides them in his tent

questions.text: What does Yahweh do with the stars?
questions.explanation: He counts the number of the stars and calls them all by their names.

answers.text: He counts their number and calls them all by their names
He makes them bow before him
He sets them as signs for the seasons
He commands them to fight for Israel

questions.text: How does the psalm describe the Lord's understanding?
questions.explanation: It says, "Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite."

answers.text: It is deeper than the sea
It is past tracing out by angels

questions.text: Besides the livestock, who does God provide food for when they call?
questions.explanation: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

questions.text: What does Yahweh not delight in, according to verse 10?
questions.explanation: The psalm says he doesn't delight in the strength of the horse, and takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

questions.text: In whom does Yahweh take pleasure?
questions.explanation: Yahweh takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.

answers.text: Those who are mighty and strong in battle
Those who fast and mourn before him daily
Those who fear him and hope in his loving kindness
Those who give their riches to the poor

questions.text: What does God fill Zion with, according to verses 12-14?
questions.explanation: After calling Jerusalem and Zion to praise, the psalm says he makes peace in her borders and fills her with the finest of the wheat.
The psalm says he gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.

questions.text: To whom does God show his word, his statutes and his ordinances?
questions.explanation: He shows his word to Jacob, and his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.

answers.text: All the nations of the earth
